◆ excludeActors

DynamicArray<ActorHandle> superdex::prefab::ExportParams::excludeActors {}

Handles of actors that ExportScene should not export.

Excluding an articulated actor also excludes all of its nested link actors. Excluding a soft-skinned actor also excludes all of its nested link actors and nested soft actors. Any contact filter or contact-pair parameter override entries that reference excluded actors are dropped.

Note
Nested link and nested soft actor handles are rejected. Pass the top-level articulated or soft-skinned actor handle instead.
Ignored by ExportActor.

◆ exportCurrentPose

bool superdex::prefab::ExportParams::exportCurrentPose = false

Whether to export the current pose of soft and articulated actors.

When true, the current elastic displacements of soft actors (including nested soft actors of soft-skinned actors) are written to SoftActorPrefab::nodeDisplacements, and the current joint pose of articulated actors (including soft-skinned skeletons) is written to ArticulatedActorPrefab::jointPose. Adding the exported prefab to a scene then restores that pose. Actors exactly at rest omit these fields.

Note
When false (the default), soft displacement and articulated joint pose fields are omitted. Actor transforms are exported regardless of this option.
Displacements of ROM soft actors are never exported.
Velocities (soft nodal and articulated joint) are never exported.
A prefab with exported soft displacements cannot be added to a scene with experimental::RomParams. Set this to false to export a prefab for that use.
